crisisResources.title: If you need help right now
crisisResources.hospitalBody: Call emergency services and they will direct you to the nearest emergency department.
crisisResources.requestCall: Ask a professional to call me now
crisisResources.requestCallHint: A member of our clinical team will call you within minutes.
crisisResources.step1: Move away from anything you could use to hurt yourself.
crisisResources.step2: Call someone you trust, or ask them to stay with you.
crisisResources.step3: Breathe slowly: in for 4 seconds, out for 6 seconds.
crisisResources.helpingBody: Stay with them, ask them directly whether they are thinking about hurting themselves, and call emergency services if they are in danger.
crisisResources.abroad: Outside the service area? The international emergency number <call>{number}</call> works in many countries.
